Class AbstractAnnotationBuilder<A extends Annotation>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.core.annotation.AbstractAnnotationBuilder<A>
Type Parameters:
A - The annotation type
All Implemented Interfaces:
AnnotationBuilder<A>
@Internal public abstract class AbstractAnnotationBuilder<A extends Annotation> extends Object implements AnnotationBuilder<A>
The base class of the generated AnnotationBuilders: the generated class says what the annotation type looks like and how to instantiate its implementation, this class resolves and converts the members.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
